caption: The drawing consists of two black ink line sketches of a table on a yellowed, lightly stained, off-white background. On the left is a side view of the table, showing four straight legs with the tabletop above, which has a drop-leaf design indicated by curved dotted lines and straight dashed lines for the extended leaf positions. The main body of the table includes a center support and joinery detail, with a notched component and angled inner line. On the right is a front view of the same table, with two straight front legs and a single drawer in the center, identified by a circular drawer pull and horizontal rectangular border. The drop leaves are again indicated by curved dotted lines. Measurements (such as "2' 4 3/4" and "2' 4 1/2") are written in pencil or ink above both views, showing slight dimensional variances. The lines are precise, and all details are rendered in a technical, architectural style.
title: Table
